name: Biodiversity data ETL
description: A Flex Template that ingest biodiversity data and updates Elasticsearch indices and BigQuery tagles

parameters.name: input_path
parameters.label: Input path
parameters.helpText: The path and filename prefix for input files. Example: gs://prj-ext-prod-biodiv-data-in-asg/*jsonl

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.label: Output destination
parameters.helpText: The path and filename prefix for writing the output. Example: gs://prj-ext-prod-biodiv-data-in-asg/output

parameters.name: bq_dataset_name
parameters.label: BigQuery dataset name
parameters.helpText: BigQuery dataset name, can only be one of erga, dtol, asg, gbdp

parameters.name: annotation_path
parameters.label: Annotation input path
parameters.helpText: Optional. GCS path to the annotation JSONL file produced by the annotation importer. Example: gs://prj-ext-prod-biodiv-data-in-aegis/annotations/PRJEB80366.jsonl
